page.title: Your account
page.guest: You're using StartWise as a guest. Your plan is saved on this phone only.
page.saveCta: Save my plan with an account
page.confirmDeletePlan: Delete this plan and everything in it?
page.privacy1: We only keep what your plan needs: your idea, numbers, notes and tasks.
page.privacy2: We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or photos, and never send them to the AI.
page.privacy3: You can delete everything, any time.
page.deleteAllBody: This removes all your plans, notes, tasks and your account. It can't be undone.
